highlights: The AI agent landscape is rapidly evolving with major releases like Google's SAM for secure P2P communication and Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5 for enterprise vulnerability scanning, alongside Google's AMIE advancing medical AI.

Significant model optimizations and releases are enhancing performance and accessibility, including Liquid AI's LFM2.5-DSpark for faster decoding, Cartesia's SOTA streaming TTS model, and Meta's open-source multimodal Muse Glimmer.

Developer tools are streamlining AI deployment and integration, notably NVIDIA's TensorRT Model Connect for native C++ inference and Google's expanded Gemini API Managed Agents for robust agent development.

agents.title: Anthropic Brings Claude Mythos 5 to Claude Security
agents.summary: Anthropic has integrated its advanced cyber-capable model, Claude Mythos 5, into Claude Security, enabling enterprise teams to perform frontier vulnerability scanning on GitHub repositories without direct model access, tracing data flows and suggesting patches.

agents.title: Google Open-Sources SAM: Zero-Config, Zero-Trust P2P Network for AI Agents
agents.summary: Google has released SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh), an Apache-2.0 open-source project, providing a zero-config, zero-trust P2P overlay network that allows AI agents to securely discover and utilize each other's tools across diverse environments without exposing internal endpoints.

agents.title: Google's AMIE Demonstrates Real-Time Clinical Video Consultations
agents.summary: Google's research medical AI system, AMIE, has showcased real-time clinical video consultation capabilities in a pioneering study, indicating significant advancements in AI's application within healthcare diagnostics and patient interaction.

models.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-DSpark Draft Models for 3.18x Faster Decoding
models.summary: Liquid AI has introduced LFM2.5-DSpark draft models, leveraging speculative decoding to achieve up to 3.18x faster decoding speeds for LFM2.5 without altering model outputs, significantly enhancing inference efficiency.

models.title: Cartesia Ships Sonic-3.6: SOTA Streaming TTS Model
models.summary: Cartesia has launched Sonic-3.6, a streaming text-to-speech model built on state space models that now leads both Artificial Analysis speech leaderboards, offering sub-90ms time-to-first-audio for high-performance, low-latency applications.

models.title: Meta Introduces Muse Glimmer: Local, Agentic, Multimodal, and Open Source
models.summary: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, a new open-source, local, agentic, and multimodal model, marking a significant contribution to the open AI ecosystem with broad capabilities for diverse applications.

tools.title: NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview
tools.summary: NVIDIA has launched TensorRT Model Connect (TRTMC) in public preview, an Apache-2.0 project enabling seamless conversion of Hugging Face or local checkpoints to end-to-end TensorRT native C++ inference with just two commands, eliminating intermediate ONNX export.

tools.title: Expanding Managed Agents in Gemini API with 3.6 Flash, Hooks, and More
tools.summary: Google is significantly enhancing Managed Agents in the Gemini API with new capabilities including 3.6 Flash and hooks, empowering developers to build more reliable and production-ready AI agents with advanced features like background tasks and remote MCP.

tools.title: Google Sheets Canvas: Bring Your Spreadsheet Data to Life with AI
tools.summary: Google Sheets canvas introduces new AI-powered features, allowing users to transform raw data into interactive dashboards, custom study trackers, and seating charts with simple prompts, significantly enhancing data visualization and analysis capabilities.

companies.title: Best GPU Neoclouds 2026: CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda, Crusoe, and Groq Ranked
companies.summary: MarkTechPost provides a detailed ranking of the top GPU neocloud providers, including CoreWeave, Nebius, Lambda, Crusoe, and Groq, analyzing their pricing, financials, power capacity, and anchor contracts, offering crucial insights for builders seeking optimal AI infrastructure.

companies.title: OpenAI Offers Zero Data Retention for Frontier Models
companies.summary: OpenAI is reaffirming its commitment to data privacy by offering Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers, alongside a preview of Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety, addressing critical enterprise concerns regarding data security with frontier models.

companies.title: Replit Expands Software Creation Access with GPT-5.6 Luna Free Mode
companies.summary: Replit has partnered with OpenAI to introduce Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, democratizing access to AI-powered software creation by allowing users to turn ideas into working code without concerns over token costs.

learning.title: Auditing Preference Biases and Fine-Tuning LMs with DPO, TRL, and LoRA
learning.summary: This tutorial provides an end-to-end workflow for fine-tuning language models using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), demonstrating how to audit the Anthropic HH-RLHF dataset for biases and implement a robust training pipeline with TRL and LoRA.

learning.title: Building Agentic Document Intelligence Pipelines with AutoFigure
learning.summary: This tutorial explores AutoFigure, a practical toolkit for developers to generate professional scientific figures directly from text descriptions and research papers, detailing environment setup and configuring API-backed generation workflows for complex document intelligence.

learning.title: The Builder’s Guide to GPT‑5.6
learning.summary: OpenAI has released a comprehensive guide for builders, showcasing how startups are leveraging GPT-5.6 to develop faster and more cost-efficient AI agents through smarter model selection and new Responses API capabilities.
